say:1:1220510001:1.text: Alas, these little pigs are a handful! Just look at how much trouble they get up to...
say:1:1220510001:1.source_cn: 唉，我家这些小猪崽，就是不让人省心！真是给你们添麻烦了。

say:3:1220510002:1.text: There's still another pig in the Water Wights camp, but it's so angry that no one can get close to it!
say:3:1220510002:1.source_cn: 大婶，水鬼帮营地还有一只猪。但它一直在发怒，不肯让我们近身。

say:4:1220510003:0.text: Oh, you must mean the strongest piglet! No wonder I haven't seen it!
say:4:1220510003:0.source_cn: 哦，你说的肯定是最健硕的那只小猪！我说怎么没看见它呢！

choice_prompt:5:1220510003.text: Oh, you must mean the strongest piglet! No wonder I haven't seen it!
choice_prompt:5:1220510003.source_cn: 哦，你说的肯定是最健硕的那只小猪！我说怎么没看见它呢！

say:6:1220510006:2.text: That's easy! There's a bell in my house that my husband and son would use to train the piglets.
say:6:1220510006:2.source_cn: 这事好办！我家有个铃铛，是以前我丈夫和儿子拿来训练小猪...

say:7:1220510007:1.text: But... they've been gone for many years. Of the pigs we had back then, only this one remains. The others all came after.
say:7:1220510007:1.source_cn: 不过……唉，他们都离开好多年了。当时养的那些猪，也只剩...

say:8:1220510008:1.text: That bell hasn't been used in ages, and I've forgotten which box it's in. I'm afraid it won't be easy to dig up now.
say:8:1220510008:1.source_cn: 那铃铛很久不用，我都忘记收到哪个包裹里了。现在想找出来...

say:9:1220510009:1.text: Perhaps you could help me find it?
say:9:1220510009:1.source_cn: 你们要是不介意，就帮我一起找一下吧。

say:11:1220510004:0.text: Just a habit of expression. From the first farrow of piglets my husband raised, this is the only one left.
say:11:1220510004:0.source_cn: 叫习惯了而已。当年我丈夫养的第一批小猪里，就只剩下这一只了。
say:11:1220510004:0.male: Just a habit of expression. From the first farrow of piglets my husband raised, this is the only one left.
say:11:1220510004:0.female: Just a habit of expression. From the first farrow of piglets my husband raised, this is the only one left.

say:12:1220510005:0.text: That explains why it's bigger than the others. Is there anything we can do to tame it?
say:12:1220510005:0.source_cn: 难怪它的体型比其他小猪都要大呢。那有没有什么可以驯服它...

choice:5:1:2.text: Do you know a way to pacify it?
choice:5:1:2.male: Do you know a way to pacify it?
choice:5:1:2.female: Do you know a way to pacify it?
